verdict.rationale: Solid's README explicitly claims full SSR and serverless support with streaming and progressive hydration "to get to interactive as quickly as possible." It also lists isomorphic client/server rendering, which matches the story directly. One community critique advises avoiding Suspense, which streaming relies on, but gives no concrete streaming-SSR failure, so it only tempers confidence. missing for 10: in-depth SSR/streaming documentation beyond README bullet points, independent or hands-on corroboration that streaming SSR improves time-to-interactive.
